Roll Call

New Commission Business
Approve an increase of 611 consecutive calendar days for Ductile Iron Water Main Replacement, Sewer Replacement and Pavement Renovation
Accept work performed by Monterey Mechanical Co. for a total contract amount of $10,996,642
Accept work performed by Cal State Constructors for a total contract amount of $3,556,700
Approve an increase of 621 consecutive calendar days to the existing contract duration for As-Needed Sewer Sealing

Approve the terms and conditions of, and authorize the GM to execute Amendment No. 1 to the License Agreement with C5 Children’s School extending the term by five years
Approve Amendment No. 2 and retroactively approve Amendment No. 1 to Agreement No. CS-344, Power Scheduling Coordination and Related Support Services, with APX Inc.
Approve the award of a Green Infrastructure Grant in the amount of up to $1,118,958 to the Archdiocese of S.F. Parish and School Juridic Persons Real Property Support Corp
